title: Calling Conventions for Different C++ Compilers and Operating Systems
author: Agner Fog
description: The fifth of Agner Fog's optimization manuals. Documents how C++ compilers on x86 pass arguments, return values, and objects; name mangling schemes; exception handling; object file formats; and how to write code portable across compilers.
